evidence.quote: If the economy evolves as I am expecting, it will likely become appropriate to begin easing policy sometime later this year.
there are several reasons why I remain optimistic that improving supply and cooling demand will support continued disinflation.
a preponderance of the labor market data indicates that labor market supply and demand are coming into better balance.
Another risk I am focused on is that a further cooling of the U.S. economy could lead to a sharp deterioration in labor market conditions.
We need to see more progress toward 2 percent inflation before I will have confidence that inflation is moving sustainably toward that objective.

parsed.rationale: The speaker is optimistic about disinflation, notes a cooling labor market and downside risks to employment, and signals likely easing later this year. She still says inflation is too high and policy has more work to do, so the overall lean is moderately dovish.
